Lizzy Mendoza: Quick update — we’re launching a small pilot for an internal rotational program called BridgeSwap and rolling out Headcount Policy v2 today. Details below + action items. :sparkles:
Lizzy Mendoza: TL;DR — BridgeSwap: 2-quarter rotations for cross-team skill sharing (infra <> product <> platform); priority hiring approved for Capacity & Observability; Headcount Policy v2 adds a required business-ROI stub on all HC requests. Doc: https://redwood-internal/people/bridgeswap-v1
Claire Wu: Congrats on getting this out — is the hiring pause still in effect? curious about exceptions.
Lizzy Mendoza: Good q. Hiring pause remains org-wide for non-priority reqs until June 30. Exceptions: SLA-driven capacity, security, and revenue-impacting roles. Priority list posted in the doc.
Jeffrey Chen: How does v2 change approvals? does it add more steps for managers?
Lizzy Mendoza: Approval flow simplified: Manager -> TL -> Finance & Capacity review (if GPU/infra) -> People Ops. We added an ROI stub and 1-paragraph customer-impact field. Approval SLA target = 3 business days for priority, 7 for others. Pseudocode in doc: ```Approval: manager.submit() -> auto-check(cost_center) -> finance.review() -> people.approve()```
Headcount Bot: Automated note: "Headcount Policy v2 template added to /tools/hc-request. All pending drafts reset to v2 on next save." :robot_face:
Meera Singh: For Dedicated capacity: will approved priority reqs trigger immediate capacity reservations or just hiring headcount? we need to avoid overprovisioning.
Rajiv Kapoor: Hi all — I’ll be Head of Capacity as of next Monday. Our plan: short-term we’ll favor slot-reservations over full-time overprovisioning. Hiring reqs tagged #capacity-priority will get an infra-impact check before offer.
Anna Greene: Welcome Rajiv! For the BridgeSwap pilots, what’s the expected onboarding for rotational hires? will we do shadow weeks or formal handoffs?
Lizzy Mendoza: Welcome Rajiv! BridgeSwap plan includes: 2-week shadowing + 1-week overlap handoff at rotation boundaries, and a 1-page learning objective per swap. Volunteers can apply — managers nominate 1 per team for the pilot cohort.
Jeffrey Chen: Any change to comp approvals or leveling for swapped roles?
Rajiv Kapoor: No comp changes for swaps — participants remain on original team’s comp path. Role-leveling exceptions must go through People Ops.
Meera Singh: Noted. Also — can we get a consolidated list of priority reqs and their business owner? will help capacity planning.
Lizzy Mendoza: Yes — I’ll publish an updated spreadsheet (read-only) by EOD with owners and requested start dates.
Claire Wu: Thanks. One ask: can we have the BridgeSwap pilot include a half-day onboarding checklist for infra safety reviews?
Rajiv Kapoor: Absolutely — I’ll work with Security and Infra to produce a checklist.
Anna Greene: Happy to help coordinate onboarding docs and run a 30-min kickoff sync for the pilot.
Lizzy Mendoza: Amazing — I’ll set the kickoff for next Wed 10am PST. RSVP in the doc. :calendar:
Headcount Bot: Reminder set: kickoff scheduled by Lizzy Mendoza on 1728540000.
Lizzy Mendoza: Action items: 1) People Ops to publish priority HC list (EOD) 2) Rajiv to draft infra-impact checklist (Fri) 3) Managers: start BridgeSwap nominations (1 per team) 4) All: review Headcount Policy v2 and provide feedback on the doc thread.
Claire Wu: Thanks — appreciate the clarity. :thumbsup:
Rajiv Kapoor: Excited to get started. Ping me directly for capacity triage.
Jeffrey Chen: Noted.
Anna Greene: I’ll add onboarding checklist to the docs repo after kickoff.
Lizzy Mendoza: Thanks everyone — will follow up after the kickoff with next steps.
